text: トレーナーに　なったばかりの　おとうとを　つよく　したいの　また　おねがいね！

structure.jp: トレーナーに　なったばかりの　おとうとを
structure.en: my little brother, who has only just become a Trainer

patterns.name: 〜たばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a past verb means it only just happened. With の it describes the brother. なったばかり = 'has only just become'.

patterns.name: 〜くする
patterns.explanation: The く form of a describing word with する means 'make something be that way'. つよく　したい = 'I want to make him strong'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do' it. したい = 'want to make'.
